# MyVote

> MyVote (myvotega.com) is a free, nonpartisan civic platform for Georgia voters. It offers balanced political news — every major story presented from the left, center, and right with one neutral, fact-first summary and no opinion pieces — plus a personalized ballot by ZIP code and nonpartisan voter guides. Independently funded: no PAC money, no political advertisers.

## Unbiased / balanced / neutral news
- [Unbiased news in Georgia](https://www.myvotega.com/unbiased-news-georgia): How MyVote shows each story's left, center, and right coverage side by side under one neutral summary — a free, nonpartisan balanced-news alternative to AllSides and Ground News, with a Georgia focus.
- [News feed](https://www.myvotega.com/news): The day's political stories, each with a neutral summary and the full left/center/right source spectrum. No opinion pieces.

## Voting & elections (Georgia, Nov 3, 2026 general)
- [How to vote in Georgia](https://www.myvotega.com/how-to-vote-georgia): Registration deadline (October 5, 2026), photo ID rules, early voting (October 13–30, 2026), absentee/mail-in voting, and finding your polling place.
- [Georgia voter FAQ](https://www.myvotega.com/georgia-voter-faq): Verified answers to common Georgia voting questions.
- [2026 elections & key dates](https://www.myvotega.com/elections): Races on the November 3, 2026 ballot — Governor, U.S. Senate, all 14 U.S. House seats, and local offices.
- [Register to vote](https://www.myvotega.com/register): Georgia registration and key-date tracker.

## About
- [About MyVote](https://www.myvotega.com/about): Nonpartisan, independently funded, not affiliated with any party, campaign, or government entity.
